reasoning: We need answer Chinese multiple choice. Need solve. Problem: using demand factor method calculate capacitor compensation capacity. Before power factor 0.8, after 0.9, total active calculated load 750 kW. Find capacitor reactive compensation capacity approximate. Formula Qc = P (tan φ1 - tan φ2). cos1=0.8 => tan1=0.75 (since sin=0.6, tan=0.75). cos2=0.9 => sin=sqrt(1-0.81)=sqrt0.19=0.435889, tan=0.484322. Difference=0.265678. *750=199.2585 kvar. Option C 200kvar. Need provide final with 答案：C. Could include brief explanation. Ensure last line exact format.
content:
补偿容量可按公式计算：

\[
Q_c = P(\tan\varphi_1 - \tan\varphi_2)
\]

其中：

- 补偿前功率因数：\(\cos\varphi_1 = 0.8\)，则 \(\tan\varphi_1 = 0.75\)
- 补偿后功率因数：\(\cos\varphi_2 = 0.9\)，则 \(\tan\varphi_2 \approx 0.484\)
- 有功计算负荷：\(P = 750\text{kW}\)

因此：

\[
Q_c = 750 \times (0.75 - 0.484) \approx 199.5\text{kvar}
\]

约为 \(200\text{kvar}\)。

答案：C
